alt: 社區花園裡，一位女子微笑協調兩旁鄰居，大家順利交換幼苗並準備花盆。
scene_prompt: At a community garden, an adult coordinator stands between two small teams and calmly helps both: with an open friendly gesture she connects a neighbor offering seedlings on the left with a neighbor preparing flowerpots on the right. Both groups respond with relieved appreciative smiles; neatly organized plants and tools show the task proceeding smoothly. Emphasize tactful easy coordination, balanced composition, ordinary two arms only.
